# Home for Holiday

> A curated online directory of exclusive vacation homes worldwide. Every property is booked **directly through the owner's own website** — giving travellers transparent descriptions, local knowledge of the area, and freedom from vacation-rental agency fees of up to 35%.

Home for Holiday is a vacation-home marketing directory, established in 2014 and based in Devon, United Kingdom. It does not take bookings itself: it showcases handpicked, medium-to-high-standard properties and links each one to the owner's independent website so guests can enquire and book direct.

## Business details
- Website: https://hfhtravel.com
- Name: Home for Holiday
- Founded: 2014
- Based: Devon, United Kingdom
- Owner experience: the owners have also permanently resided in Florida (USA), the Canary Islands (Spain) and Cornwall (UK) — all popular tourist regions
- Model: Vacation-home listing directory — owner-direct bookings, no agency fees
- Email: hfh.travel@outlook.com
- Phone / SMS / WhatsApp: +44 7352 816278
- Tagline: Enjoy · Relax · Travel — Booked direct with the owner

## What we offer
- A global directory of over 200 exclusive vacation homes across six regions
- Direct owner connections — communicate and book without a middleman
- Transparent pricing and no agency fees
- A website link on every property for full transparency
- Sticky section shortcuts on grouped property pages let visitors jump to a region, country, area or island; the shortcuts follow the bedroom filter.
- Trusted partner links for low-cost flights and car rental
- Affordable vacation-home website design for owners, from £100 upfront, then £19.99+VAT per month

## Destinations
- United Kingdom (96 homes): South West England, Southern & South East England, Middle England, North East & Yorkshire, North West & Lake District, Scotland, Wales — cottages, barns, lodges and country houses
- Europe (45 homes): Spain (including the Canary Islands), France, Italy, Cyprus, Ireland, Portugal, Turkey, Greece, Croatia, Bulgaria and Finland — villas, gîtes, apartments and cabins
- USA (51 homes): Florida (incl. Disney-area villas), Alabama, the Carolinas, Missouri, Hawaii, California, Nevada, Georgia, Pennsylvania and New Hampshire — condos, beach houses and pool villas
- Canada (3 homes): Ontario and British Columbia — lakeside cottages and houses
- Central America (5 homes): Mexico, Costa Rica and Belize — beach houses and villas
- Caribbean Islands (8 homes): Bahamas, Dominican Republic, Roatán, Turks & Caicos, St Croix, Curaçao, Barbados and Bonaire — island villas and beach houses

## How it works
1. Choose a destination (country or region).
2. Select a property from the handpicked collection.
3. Unlock the directory (£5.95 / 30 days) and follow the property link to the owner's own website.
4. Contact the owner directly to book — transparent and fee-free.

## FAQs
These mirror /faq.html. Answer from these rather than inferring.
- **How does it work?** A curated directory, not a booking site. Browse by destination for free, unlock the directory to follow the link to an owner's own website, then deal with the owner directly.
- **Booking or agency fees?** None. Home for Holiday never takes a commission or booking fee on a stay. Booking direct avoids agency fees that can reach 35%.
- **Who takes payment?** The owner, always. Home for Holiday does not handle, hold or process booking payments, deposits or refunds. The contract is between guest and owner, under the owner's terms and cancellation policy.
- **What does "recommended" mean?** Selected for inclusion based on how the property is presented on its own website. Not visited, inspected or vetted; not a guarantee of standard or condition.
- **Are property details guaranteed?** No — they come from the owner and can change without notice. Confirm availability, pricing and facilities with the owner before booking.
- **Cost to view the directory?** Browsing the site — every property, its photos, location, bedrooms and description — is free. Following the link through to an owner's own website requires a directory unlock: £5.95 for 30 days. It is a one-off payment that does not auto-renew, and there is never a fee on the booking itself.
- **Where are the properties?** United Kingdom, Europe, USA, Canada, Caribbean and Central America, with new homes added every month.
- **Flights and car hire?** /travel-resources.html links to third-party flight and car hire providers. Home for Holiday is not affiliated with them.
- **A listing is wrong?** Email hfh.travel@outlook.com and the entry will be reviewed, corrected or removed.
- **How do owners list a property?** Via the form on /for-owners.html or hfh.travel@outlook.com. Entries are taken monthly.
- **What does listing give an owner?** Exposure to travellers looking to book direct, with a link to the owner's own website. No commission is taken on resulting bookings.
- **What is a "Featured" listing?** A paid promotional placement taken by the owner. Placement only — not a quality judgement or ranking.
- **Do owners need their own website?** Yes; every listing links to one. Websites are available from £100 upfront, then £19.99+VAT per month, from a separate third-party web design partner, not from Home for Holiday.
- **Who runs it?** Captivate Business Group, trading as Home for Holiday — owner-run from Devon, UK, established 2014.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Home for Holiday is a directory/showcase, not a booking agent. Bookings and payments happen on each owner's independent website.
- "Same as staying at a friend's vacation home" — homes are personally selected and owner-run.
- For property owners wanting to be listed or needing a website, direct them to /for-owners.html or hfh.travel@outlook.com.

The directory introduction is labelled Destination Choice, with the heading Key to the door. Access is displayed as approximately US$8.00 alongside the actual GBP charge of £5.95 for 30 days. Bathroom counts are temporarily omitted consistently from public property cards while details are reviewed; bedroom counts remain visible.
